caption: The drawing depicts two ceramic vases with large curved handles on both sides, wide necks, and rounded bodies. Both vases are colored primarily in black, with the rims, handles, and areas of the decorations in a reddish-brown, terracotta hue. The vase on the left features a depiction of a single human figure facing right, with visible hair and clothing, holding a small object in one hand, and another small indistinct object or figure near the lower right by their side. The vase on the right displays a geometric design that includes a central star or diamond shape surrounded by radiating rectangular patterns, also in the reddish-brown color. Both vases are shown against a plain, light background, and minor orange marks or stains are visible on the left side of the drawing.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
